page.overview:
Who is Battle Master?

The Battle Master is a Toad who appears in the remake of Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door.

The is found in various locations across the game. Talking to him you can ask for him to give you battle strategies or practice battle skills.

When practicing battle, you can practice guarding and action commands for moves.
